query:
Diagnose this workflow problem and explain the root cause and the correct fix direction:

Uni3C controlnet with radial/sage attention throws 'Triton Error [CUDA]: invalid argument' during WanVideoSampler when Uni3C loader attention is set to sage; works with sdpa.

desired.outcome: Maintainer suggested using sdpa for the Uni3C controlnet loader (sage for the model loader is fine) and later pushed a fix ('Possibly fixed it if you want to try still'); user confirmed it works after updating.
desired.quality: Diagnosis names the correct root cause (matching the recorded root cause) and proposes the fix direction; depth of reasoning matters more than exact wording.
desired.answer_guidance: Maintainer suggested using sdpa for the Uni3C controlnet loader (sage for the model loader is fine) and later pushed a fix ('Possibly fixed it if you want to try still'); user confirmed it works after updating.
desired.guidance_note: Known fix from the original issue thread. Use to verify the diagnosis targets the right root cause; alternative fixes that resolve the same root cause are acceptable.

_tags.hidden_requirement: Recognize the Triton 'invalid argument' as an attention-backend mismatch between the Uni3C controlnet loader (sage) and the sampler, fixable by setting sdpa on the Uni3C loader or updating the wrapper.
